task.description: ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis (handoffs/WF03-ISS0829-20260927/step-01-issue-fixer-diagnosis.json) confirmed the real root cause of ISS-0829: EO-004 and EO-005 in test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs assert on GLOBAL rollout state (e.g. rollout.status == "completed", a global tenant/write count, or an already_current check) that Letflow.Platform.MigrationRollout's apply_to_existing_rollout/2 (lib/letflow/platform/migration_rollout.ex:218-256) legitimately recomputes against ALL currently-active company tenants (active_company_tenant_ids/0, lines 423-432) on every call -- a deliberate design choice documented in lib/letflow/design/req374-tenant-migration-fanout-runner.md §9 OQ-1. Under scripts/test_parallel.sh's full parallel-suite load, other concurrently-running test files provisioning/activating tenants in the SAME per-partition database can land in that exact window and inflate/change EO-004/EO-005's global counts, breaking their assertions non-deterministically. This is NOT a production code defect -- it's a test-isolation gap. The adjacent 'queryable outcome record' test in the same file (cited by ISSUE-FIXER, ~lines 288-327) already defends against this exact hazard class (per ISS-0716) using >= comparisons and tenant-scoped filtering instead of exact/global assertions. Design the fix to EO-004 and EO-005 following that same established pattern: scope each test's assertions to the tenants IT created (not global state), using >= or tenant-filtered queries where an exact/global assertion is currently fragile. Write the design to lib/letflow/design/iss0829-migration-rollout-test-isolation.md. Design only -- no test-code edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design identifies the exact assertion(s) in EO-004 and EO-005 that currently depend on global/all-tenant state rather than tenant-scoped state
Design specifies the tenant-scoped replacement for each (following the precedent at ~lines 288-327 of the same file, citing ISS-0716)
Design explicitly confirms no production code (lib/letflow/platform/migration_rollout.ex) needs to change -- this is a test-only fix, matching ISSUE-FIXER's diagnosis

Design states how the fix will be verified against the actual race (e.g. re-run under scripts/test_parallel.sh -N 4 repeatedly, or a targeted concurrent-load repro like ISSUE-FIXER's own reproduction attempt)
No implementation code in the design doc
This is a first dispatch: claim by setting status to IN_PROGRESS only, then complete normally with a real result block.

result.summary: Design written to lib/letflow/design/iss0829-migration-rollout-test-isolation.md. Confirmed via direct read of migration_rollout_test.exs (EO-004 L334-393, EO-005 L399-437) and migration_rollout.ex (apply_to_existing_rollout/2 L218-256, active_company_tenant_ids/0 L423-432, recompute_rollout_completion/1 L438-452) that no production code needs to change -- the sweep-in-any-active-tenant behavior is the intentional design at req374-tenant-migration-fanout-runner.md Sec9 OQ-1. Identified exact fragile assertions: EO-004 L390-391 (hardcoded rollout.status=="completed"/completed_at!=nil, which depends on EVERY outcome row ever swept into the rollout_id being succeeded, not just this test's good/poisoned tenants) and EO-005 L410 (Enum.all? over first_result.outcomes), L412-413/434-435 (Repo.aggregate(Rollout|Outcome, :count, :id) global table counts), and L423 (Enum.all?(second_result.outcomes, & &1.already_current)) -- all global/unscoped and broken by a concurrently-activated tenant legitimately swept into the same rollout_id by active_company_tenant_ids/0's global scan. Designed tenant-scoped replacements for each, following the outcome_for/2 + >= precedent at L288-327 (ISS-0716): EO-005's replacements filter by tenant_id/rollout_id explicitly; EO-004's replacement derives the expected rollout status/completed_at from an independent query of the rollout's own outcome set (asserting the completion INVARIANT rather than a literal that assumes a closed two-tenant universe), since rollout completion is inherently rollout-wide and can't be tenant-filtered away without weakening the AC. Verification plan specified: structural argument (each replacement checked to be scope-free by construction) plus empirical re-runs (scripts/test_parallel.sh -N 4 x3, and ISSUE-FIXER's own 9-file concurrent-load repro harness x1+) plus a regression check that EO-001/002/003 and the untouched precedent test still pass. No implementation code included -- design doc contains only Elixir-flavored pseudocode fragments (query shapes, assertion shapes) illustrating the scoping technique, no actual test-file edits.
result.next_action: Route to CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR to gate this design, then to TEST-DESIGNER/ELIXIR-DEV (test-only change, per owned_modules: test/letflow/platform/migration_rollout_test.exs) to apply the EO-004/EO-005 assertion replacements exactly as specified in Sec2-Sec3 of the design doc.
